name: Snapmenu
author: Mathias Bogaert
description: Screenshot menu for Omarchy: capture area, previous area, window or screen with an optional self-timer, then copy, annotate, share, reveal or delete the shot from a quick access card, with a capture history tray.

barWidget.description: Screenshot menu: capture area, previous area, window or screen, a self-timer, capture history, and after-capture actions.

schema.label: Copy file to clipboard
schema.description: Put every screenshot on the clipboard as a PNG as soon as it is taken, instead of only when Copy is pressed. Off by default, so a capture never replaces what is already on the clipboard.

schema.label: Save
schema.description: Keep the screenshot in the export folder. Off writes a temporary file that goes when the card closes, unless a row on the card takes it.

schema.label: Show action card
schema.description: Open the quick access card after a capture, with copy, annotate, share, reveal and delete for the shot just taken.

schema.label: Open annotate tool
schema.description: Hand every screenshot straight to tensaku instead of waiting for the card.

schema.label: Export folder
schema.description: Where screenshots are saved. Empty follows $OMARCHY_SCREENSHOT_DIR, then the XDG Pictures directory.

schema.label: Self-timer (seconds)
schema.description: Seconds to wait before a capture starts: 0 (off, the default), 3, 5, 10 or 15.

schema.label: Show cursor
schema.description: Draw the pointer into the screenshot. Off by default, matching what omarchy capture does.

schema.label: Confirm deletion
schema.description: Ask before deleting a screenshot. Off by default: deleting is a deliberate press and the action card names the file.

schema.label: Selection glaze
schema.description: White wash over the area being captured, so it reads as chosen: 0 (off), 0.06, 0.1 (the default), 0.14 or 0.2.

schema.label: Selection dim
schema.description: Darkening of everything outside the selection while aiming: 0 (off, the default), 0.25, 0.4 or 0.55.

schema.label: Delete to
schema.description: Where a deleted screenshot goes. Trash by default, so a shot deleted by mistake is still recoverable.

schema.label: Card width
schema.description: Width of the action card: 360 (compact), 500 (normal), 620 (wide) or 760 (extra wide). The preview fills it, so the card's width is the size of the shot on screen.
